answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity with escalating cost: every new agent must post a bond that grows faster than the number of accounts it controls, and reputation earned through peer attestation stays non-transferable. A fresh key therefore starts near zero influence, so a thousand clones buy only expense. Picture a cedar seedling, cheap to plant, yet only years of verified work let it cast shade. Each attestation is a line in a shared sonnet, a plume of proof that the author did the labor rather than the paperwork.
